sources.title: TAXII Version 2.1 OASIS Standard
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Kubernetes Audit：多階段請求關聯與截斷缺口
related.titleEn: Kubernetes Audit: multistage request correlation and truncation gaps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付pages.json、version-keys.csv、checkpoint.json與replay-test.md；不發送任何網路請求，所有封套與物件均為合成測試資料。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver pages.json, version-keys.csv, checkpoint.json and replay-test.md. Send no network requests; all envelopes and objects are original synthetic fixtures, with replay behavior reproducible from the delivered files.
related.difference: 以auditID關聯階段，保留stage、requestURI、時間與回應狀態；列出請求數、記錄列數及未觀測完成狀態的請求集合。
related.differenceEn: Correlate stages by auditID while preserving stage, requestURI, timestamps and response status. Report request count, log-row count and the set of requests whose completion state was not observed.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: TAXII 2.1以分頁與篩選傳輸STIX內容；游標是服務端續取資訊，不應自行解碼猜測。用物件ID加版本識別去重，單ID不可吞掉新版本。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 第一頁40個版本鍵、第二頁35個，其中5個與第一頁重複；第三頁25個且都新。重試時額外重送第一頁40列。 唯一版本40+35−5+25=95；正常頁面100列，加重試共140列，重複45列，重複比例45/140=32.142857%。

Kubernetes稽核政策可選事件層級及省略階段；缺少ResponseComplete不能單獨證明請求失敗，也可能是政策、長連線或收集缺口。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 100個請求ID：80個各有Received與Complete兩列、10個只有Received、10個只有Complete；合計180列，Complete可觀測90個。 請求身份為100而非180；完成階段可觀測率90/100=90%，不是API成功率，因為尚未查看回應狀態。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: TAXII 2.1 transports STIX content using filtering and pagination. Treat continuation cursors as server-issued information rather than guessing their encoding. Deduplicate object-version identities, not IDs alone, so genuine updates survive. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Page one has forty version keys; page two has thirty-five including five already on page one. Page three has twenty-five new keys. A retry additionally replays all forty rows from page one. There are 40+35−5+25=95 unique versions. Normal pages contain 100 rows; the retry raises received rows to 140, of which forty-five are duplicates, giving 32.142857%.

Kubernetes audit policy selects levels and may omit stages. A missing ResponseComplete record alone does not prove request failure; policy choices, long-running requests and collection gaps are alternative explanations. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. One hundred request identities contain eighty Received/Complete pairs, ten Received-only records and ten Complete-only records. There are 180 rows and ninety identities with an observed completion record. Request identity count is 100 rather than 180. Completion-stage observability is 90/100=90%; this is not the API success rate because response-status outcomes have not yet been evaluated.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Azure Architecture：多租戶佇列公平與noisy neighbor隔離邊界
related.titleEn: Azure Architecture: multitenant queue fairness and noisy-neighbor boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付pages.json、version-keys.csv、checkpoint.json與replay-test.md；不發送任何網路請求，所有封套與物件均為合成測試資料。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver pages.json, version-keys.csv, checkpoint.json and replay-test.md. Send no network requests; all envelopes and objects are original synthetic fixtures, with replay behavior reproducible from the delivered files.
related.difference: 列出每租戶待處理數、每批次分配與未完成餘額；用合成工作檢查保留槽位政策，不能以總完成數掩蓋個別租戶飢餓。
related.differenceEn: Record each tenant backlog, batch allocation and remaining work. Test reserved-slot policy on synthetic jobs without letting aggregate completion counts hide starvation of individual tenants.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

Azure noisy-neighbor文件討論共享資源競爭與隔離；本課的固定預留政策是教學設計，資源公平與租戶資料授權仍為不同問題。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 每批10槽、各工作同時長；A有20、B有4、C有4。無保障先取A十件；預留政策分A4、B3、C3，未使用槽才可借出。 兩方案第一批都完成10件，但B+C完成率無保障0/8=0%，預留為6/8=75%；總吞吐相同不代表租戶體驗相同。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: TAXII 2.1 transports STIX content using filtering and pagination. Treat continuation cursors as server-issued information rather than guessing their encoding. Deduplicate object-version identities, not IDs alone, so genuine updates survive. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Page one has forty version keys; page two has thirty-five including five already on page one. Page three has twenty-five new keys. A retry additionally replays all forty rows from page one. There are 40+35−5+25=95 unique versions. Normal pages contain 100 rows; the retry raises received rows to 140, of which forty-five are duplicates, giving 32.142857%.

Azure noisy-neighbor guidance discusses contention and isolation in shared resources. The fixed-reservation policy here is a teaching design; resource fairness remains distinct from tenant data-access authorization. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Each batch has ten slots and equal-duration jobs. Backlogs are A twenty, B four and C four. An unreserved A-first batch takes ten A jobs; the reserved policy allocates A four, B three and C three. Both policies finish ten jobs in the first batch. B+C completion is 0/8=0% without reservation and 6/8=75% with reservation; equal aggregate throughput does not imply equal tenant experience.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
